text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, we haven't had lunch yet. 
Trainer. Does meat sound good to you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing. 
Pausing in her tracks at a savory aroma, 
Phalaenopsis spoke up.

text_block_list.name: Yakiniku Host
text_block_list.text:
Step right up! Our special 'Yakiniku 
Battle' is about to begin! 
All-you-can-eat at an astonishingly low 
price! 
Eat as much as your heart desires~~!

text_block_list.name: Yakiniku Host
text_block_list.text:
However! 
You'll be battling whoever sits at your 
table! 
Win or lose, taken or snatched, no crying 
allowed~~!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yet, take a look. 
...The warriors have already gathered.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. 
No need to hold back, then.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Survival of the fittest. Interesting.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha, now that's what I call spirited! 
I do love me some meat!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, let us go.

text_block_list.name: Server
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting~! 
Now then, the battle begins! 
Grab as much as you can, everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chopsticks arrange slices of meat across 
the grill. 
Charred over coals, savory juices slowly 
begin to drip.
choice_data_list: Ah, it's searing to a nice color...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right as the meat browned to perfection, 
at that very instant—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Fwip!!*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The meat vanished. 
Nay, it was snatched away.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Eat, or be eaten.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the explosive reflexes of a bird of 
prey, 
she wields them to plunder the sizzling 
meat one piece after another!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What is this...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, there was open space on the grill, 
see. 
So I took the liberty of filling your 
reach 
with veggies instead.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Call it a 'veggie siege' rather than a 
water siege! 
Eat your greens too, Lady Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch... Impudent pest.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: —Have you forgotten about me?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
No matter how Central tries to hoard the 
meat, 
Funabashi will surely—claim its share.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Where there is glory, there is Funabashi! 
No matter where on the grill, I will seize 
it!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaa!? 
Wait-wait-wait, that's the meat I was 
nursing!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Damn it, none of what you're saying makes 
sense...! 
Stop leaning over the table!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's a battle... An honest-to-goodness 
battle. 
A ferocity hotter than burning coals 
washes over us!
choice_data_list:
Though, if you ask whether anyone's 
actually getting to eat...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: When on earth did she even...—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
While we were fighting amongst ourselves? 
Yet, there was no such opening...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: ...Wait.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
There was one...! 
The single instant our eyes left the 
grill...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The meat I had my eye on... is nowhere to 
be found?!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Are you familiar with the term 
'zanshin'?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Even after landing a strike, one never 
drops their guard, 
keeping the spirit poised for the next.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
After taking a cut of meat, most people 
look down at their plate. 
Or perhaps their attention is stolen by 
the next bite.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yet even as she sets the meat onto her 
plate, 
she never takes her eyes off the grill. 
Chopsticks poised, posture primed—still 
aimed at the next piece.
choice_data_list:
So that is... "zanshin" applied to 
yakiniku...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: ...She applied martial arts to yakiniku!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Gwahahaha! Magnificent! 
This is what a true battle should be!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Logic matters not. 
—I will simply devour everything.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many foes stand against 
me... 
I shall seize victory with these hands!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
To one and all. 
Let the bout commence.
choice_data_list: I'll take notes on this strategy.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now now. Do not daze off. The battle is 
far from over.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Behold those tiger-like eyes. 
Drop your guard, and you will be devoured 
in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now, brace yourself— 
and survive this, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
If there was something to glean from it, 
then good.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A freshly grilled piece of galbi lands 
softly upon my plate.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Claim the next one by your own hand. 
...Understood?
